qs.q:
Choose the pair that best fills in (A) and (B).

Summary: Tourism brings (A) to the island, but the crowds put pressure on its (B).
o: pollution / income
income / resources
income / weather
culture / airports
qs.why: 관광은 소득을 주지만 물과 쓰레기 처리 같은 자원에 부담을 줘요.

qs.q: What is the debate on the island really about?
o: How many visitors the island can welcome without harm
Whether tourism should be stopped completely
Which beach on the island has the finest sand
How to build many more guesthouses near the busiest beaches
qs.why: 방문객을 어느 수준으로 받아야 섬이 살기 좋은 곳으로 남는가가 쟁점이에요.

qs.q: Why do some business owners oppose a limit on visitors?
o: They dislike cleaning the beaches.
They want higher rents on the coast.
They believe water is unlimited.
They fear losing customers.
qs.why: 방문객이 줄면 손님이 줄 것을 걱정해요.

qs.q: Which problem is caused by higher rents?
o: Boat owners have to leave the island to find new kinds of work.
Tourists refuse to visit in summer.
Some local families cannot afford to live near the coast.
Rubbish is collected twice as often.
qs.why: 집세가 올라 일부 주민이 해안가에 살기 어려워졌어요.

set.q:
Some schools now let students choose their own seats at lunch rather than assigning tables by class. At first, teachers worried that groups would exclude others. In practice, students often sat with new classmates from shared clubs, and the lunchroom grew noisier but friendlier.

Which sentence is the best summary of the paragraph?
o: Assigned tables remain the surest way to keep a lunchroom quiet.
Free seating at lunch can lead students to make new friendships.
Teachers have banned school clubs because of conflicts at lunch.
Students who choose their seats prefer to eat alone each day.
set.why: 자유 좌석이 새로운 친구 관계로 이어졌다는 것이 요지예요.

set.rule: rather than은 앞뒤를 같은 형태로 연결해요. teaching과 짝이 되도록 memorizing을 써요. support는 동명사를 목적어로 취해요.
